name: Template
description: Starting point for your own label set. Copy this file, rename it, and edit the dimensions. A dimension is either "single" (pick one label) or "pairs" (add one or more pairs, e.g. action + tool). Options are plain strings or {"value", "hint"} objects; hints appear when hovering an option.

dimensions.label: Activity
dimensions.prompt: What were you mainly doing in this time interval?

dimensions.label: Step-Resource Pair
dimensions.prompt: Which steps did you take, and what did you use for each?

dimensions.label: Confidence
dimensions.prompt: How confident were you during this time interval?
